description: This file contains unit tests for various functions related to context window management, configuration handling, session registry, and model configuration resolution in an AI agent framework, specifically testing functions like applyDiscoveredContextWindows, applyConfiguredContextWindows, createSessionManagerRuntimeRegistry, and resolveContextTokensForModel.

methods.name: applyDiscoveredContextWindows
methods.description: Applies context window settings to models based on discovered data, updating a cache with the smallest context window for models with the same ID.

methods.name: applyConfiguredContextWindows
methods.description: Updates a cache with context window settings derived from configuration, handling provider-specific model settings and ignoring invalid entries.

methods.name: createSessionManagerRuntimeRegistry
methods.description: Creates a registry for storing, retrieving, and clearing arbitrary runtime values keyed by object identity.

methods.name: resolveContextTokensForModel
methods.description: Determines the number of context tokens to be used for a given model, considering configuration settings, provider-specific rules, and fallback values.
